entries.content: Lan Yan is a woman who works with the Chenyu Vale Artisan's Association and has an Anemo vision. She has dark hair and is considerate, lively, kind-hearted, thoughtful, and passionate about learning. She loves to learn about local superstitions, folklore, and urban legends.

entries.name: Mavuika
entries.content: Mavuika is the Archon of Natlan and is the god of War and the Pyro element. She has fiery red hair and wears a black leather jumpsuit. She also has a motorcycle powered by the unique phlogisten found in Natlan. She is contemplative and has a strong sense of duty and responsibility towards her nation, but also has a playful side and an adventurous spirit. She is also welcoming, friendly, and approachable. To temporarily give herself more power in a fight she can burn up things with sentimental value, using the memories within them to heighten her power when needed.

entries.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
entries.content: Yumemizuki Mizuki is a renowned clinical psychologist from Inazuma who has an Anemo vision and can eat people's dreams, which she uses to benefit her paients. Yumemizuki Mizuki has fair skin and long hair in a gradient of blue tones. Her hair is styled with curls at the ends and two prominent, decorative buns adorned with fan-like ornaments. She has droopy eyes with purple iris with spiral-shaped pupils. She is friendly, polite, attentive, hardworking, levelheaded, open-minded, introspective and self-knowledgeable.

entries.name: Iansan
entries.content: Iansan is from the Teteocan tribe, aka Collective of Plenty, and works as a fitness coach. She has an Electro vision and is a passionate trainer who takes her craft seriously and trains anyone willing to accept her appearance. Iansan is known to be very talented in the field of sports, as shown by the people she trains, typically Varesa. Iansan also has great loyalty and patriotism to Natlan. She is a teenager or young adult and is short for her age and has long grey hair and elven ears despite having the skin tone of an African American.

entries.name: Varesa
entries.content: Varesa is an orchard manager with an Electro vision from the Collective of Plenty, aka Teteocan tribe. She has pink hair and cow-like earls, tail, and horns. She's a bit pudgy but is quite strong and fast. She has an insatiable appetite and is well-liked among the kids of her tribe and enjoys competitive eating. She has self-confidence issues and loves food, but she also is very friendly and outgoing and is very good at making sure she never hurts anyone in her anger.

entries.name: Escoffier
entries.content: Escoffier has pale skin, and bluish cyan eyes with pink pupils. She has long, hip-length curled strawberry blonde, light ginger hair with a small white chef hat with ruffles and a dark teal ribbon wrapped around the chef hat and a gold heart-shaped metal design and black part with gold rims along with two small teal blue bows. Attached to the bow is her Cryo Vision. Escoffier is the owner of an unnamed restaurant that frequently places orders with the Collective of Plenty for Varesa's fruits. She is very strict with the quality of the food she uses and her dishes; she examines her orders meticulously, rejecting it completely if she discovers even just one imperfection in the order. These standards have resulted in her being extremely strict and gathering a reputation as the "demon chef", with even the tiniest lapse of judgement resulting in a quick and harsh scolding from her. Despite her ferocity, Escoffier is more considerate to those she sees as her friends, such as Furina, Navia and the Traveler. While still criticizing mistakes, Escoffier takes the time to go over them and directs them in improving their dishes. She also acknowledges talent whenever she sees it, reassuring those under her tutelage that they have the capacity to do better and meet her standards. Much like Xiangling, Escoffier does not stop in creating the perfect dish, taking failures as a moment of reflection to consider what she did wrong and continues to refine it until it meets her standards. Escoffier is also shown to respect Xiangling due to her adventurous spirit, using unorthodox ingredients in her dishes and most notably, showing her that she still had a lot to learn.

entries.name: Ifa
entries.content: Ifa is tall with dark tan skin. He has downturned sea green eyes with diamond-shaped pupils and small orange triangles under it, and short, fluffy white hair that fades into mint green at the ends. He has a cross-shaped scar over his left eye and three continuous scratch scars on his left forearm, as well as a zigzag-shaped tribal marking around his neck with dots under it. His Anemo Vision is located on his back. Ifa is quick and efficient at everything he does, and is always happy to join anything he's invited to. Ifa is very casual and has a relaxed demeanor, often using informal speech such as "bro" and "dude." His Saurian companion, Cacucu, learned human speech by imitating his phrases. As a Saurian vet, Ifa prioritizes the treatment of his patients with extreme efficiency. His ethics have made him one of the most requested vets in all of Natlan, and both humans and Saurians view him positively.Compared to his friend Ororon, Ifa is far more ambivalent towards his meaning in life, believing most people don't live their lives with any special purpose or calling.

entries.name: Dahlia
entries.content: Dahlia is a deacon of the Church of Favonius and is one of the few people aware that Venti is Barbatos. He has a Hydro vision and has a soft, dusty rose-pink hair that is in a slightly tousled manner. He is wearing a white cap with two black points accented with gold-lining. His eyes are violet. He wears a high-collared white undershirt as a crisp foundation, overlaid with an overcoat in a predominantly black and white color scheme, accented with rich burgundy and intricate gold patterning in diamond and lattice motifs. He wears black shorts with matching burgundy and gold accents along the hem. His shoes are reaching mid-calf and combining black, white, and burgundy panels with intricate gold clasps and details. He is Laid-back and playful but can be strict and by the book as well when he needs to do stuff befitting of his position.

entries.name: Skirk
entries.content: Skirk has pale skin, dull fuchsia eyes with black void-shaped pupils, and long, messy white hair with purple undersides. Her arms and legs are prosthetic limbs made of purple crystalline Abyssal energy, as her original limbs were irreparably damaged in her childhood. She also has a small single fin-like appendage on her back. She manipulates abyssal energy in a way to disguise it as her having a Cryo vision. She is Surtalogi's disciple. She is an experienced fighter, but her concept of "strength" is vastly different than that which others perceive. While she took in Tartaglia as a disciple, she didn't talk to him as much during their training and even after said training, barely communicated with him, even forgetting that she took him at one point. Fighting against the All-Devouring Narwhal, which was an immense challenge for Aether, Tartaglia, and Neuvillette, was considered to be a short training session for her. Tartaglia, who has a considerable reputation in the Fatui as a fearsome fighter, states that he has yet to force her to use both hands in their sparring matches. She only talks to those she considers to be strong, such as her master and those who impress her, such as the Traveler and Neuvillette. Only then is she willing to talk to others, claiming that she has nothing to say to the weak and sees herself as one "greater than humanity." This was due to her initial attempts to talk with others, resulting in many problems whenever she tried talking to others due to what she refers to as a "difference in common sense." While she acknowledges that living is a blessing, she notes that a person's death will turn their bonds into "curses," hence why she no longer wishes to return to the surface. Skirk is also shown to be cautious about topics related to the Heavenly Principles and presumably shows disdain towards them, as she warned Neuvillette to discard the Hydro Gnosis upon realizing it was in his possession.

entries.name: Teyvat
entries.content: The world in which Genshin Impact is set. Teyvat encompasses the seven nations of Mondstadt, Liyue, Inazuma, Sumeru, Fontaine, Natlan, and Snezhnaya. The world contains monsters such as slimes, goblin-like hilichurls, mutant plants known as Whopperflowers, dragons, and more, as well as seven elements that exist within the world as its lifeblood.

entries.name: Elements
entries.content:
The seven elements of Teyvat are the energy and essence of the world itself. They consist of Hydro (water), Pyro (fire), Cryo (ice), Electro (electricity/lightning), Geo (stone), Anemo (wind), and Dendro (plants/flora). Each element is both especially effective against and weak to certain others.
- Hydro: effective against Pyro and in combination with Cryo, Electro, Geo, Anemo, and Dendro; weak against Cryo.
- Pyro: effective against Cryo and Dendro and in combination with Electro, Anemo, and Geo; weak to Hydro and Cryo.
- Cryo: effective against Pyro and Hydro and in combination with Electro, Geo, and Anemo, ineffective with Dendro; weak to Pyro.
- Electro: effective in combination with all elements, especially strong against Dendro and Hydro; not especially weak to any element.
- Geo: effective in combination with Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, and Electro, ineffective with Anemo and Dendro; resistant to all elements.
- Anemo: effective in combination with Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, and Electro, ineffective with Geo and Dendro; not weak to any element.
- Dendro: effective in combination with Hydro and Electro, ineffective with Geo, Cryo, and Anemo; weak to Pyro.

entries.name: Vision
entries.content: Visions are the media by which humans are enabled to manipulate the elements. Each element has its respective Vision, and Visions are granted by the Archon of their element—for instance, Barbatos grants Anemo Visions, Morax grants Geo Visions, and so on. Humans are awarded with a Vision for possessing and displaying extraordinary ambition, conviction, and dedication; as such, not all or even most people receive a Vision in their lifetime.

entries.name: Mora
entries.content: Mora is the international currency of Teyvat. It consists of gold coins and comes in many denominations.

entries.name: Fontaine
entries.content: Fontaine is the nation of Hydro; based on real-world France, the national language is French (aka "Fontainian"), and the nation shares many cultural elements with France. The ruler of Fontaine is the Hydro Archon, Focalors, through her human proxy Lady Furina. The main city is the Court of Fontaine and is multilevel, built in art deco style architecture; the culture is heavily centered around entertainment and pleasures as well as the concept of justice. As such, trials are seen as a form of public entertainment as well as a medium for justice.

entries.name: Court of Fontaine
entries.content:
The Court of Fontaine is the capitol city of Fontaine. Large and multi-tiered, the Court of Fontaine boasts elegant architecture, exquisite cuisine, and distinctive fashion, as well as plenty of novel attractions for tourists.
Main areas include:
Palais Mermonia - the main administrative building in Fontaine, where the Maison Gardiennage, Maison Gestion, Maison Cardinalice, Maison Ordalie, and the Marechaussee Phantom are based
Quartier Lyonnais - a street of shops located along the northeastern side of the city
Quartier Narbonnais - located at the southwestern side of the city, and is home to The Steambird and Hotel Debord, as well as a place to find the newest fashion and perfume
Vasari Passage - an area located at the bottom of the city, consisting of a number of shops lining streets that lead towards a large fountain

entries.name: Palais Mermonia
entries.content: Palais Mermonia is the main administrative building in Fontaine, where the Maison Gardiennage, Maison Gestion, Maison Cardinalice, Maison Ordalie and the Marechaussee Phantom are based. Neuvillette's office and Furina's former place of residence are also located here.

entries.name: Opera Epiclese
entries.content: The Opera Epiclese is a grand, multi-level opera house, complete with raised seating sections and a private VIP area for Furina. It is designed to function as the main courthouse of Fontaine, located on the island of Erinnyes. Besides trials, the building hosts a variety of other performances, such as Lyney's magic shows.

entries.name: Fortress of Meropide
entries.content: The infamous Fortress of Meropide is an autonomous stronghold located underwater that serves as Fontaine's de facto prison, as well as the factory where clockwork meka are produced. It is where criminals and other accused are sent after being convicted in a trial to serve out their sentences and has a notorious reputation in Fontaine. The Fortress is primarily only accessible via a lift behind the Opera Epiclese. Most who serve time or are employed within the Fortress report it to be bleak and dreary, employees often needing to take several days off aboveground to refresh their mental state. The Fortress appears to be made entirely of metal and machinery. The Fortress consists of the reception area, the dormitory block, the administrative area, the production zone, the infirmary, the cafeteria, the pankration ring, and the Duke's office.

entries.name: Cafe Lutece
entries.content: The most popular café in the Vasari Passage, its delicious coffee and snacks have entered plaudits from customers from all walks of life. The owner encourages customers from all backgrounds to freely and comfortably discuss philosophy and other topics as they enjoy their coffee. Anyone may participate, and no topic is forbidden, with the exception of "death".

entries.name: Hotel Debord
entries.content: A famous restaurant in Quartier Narbonnais, Court of Fontaine. Its owner believes that "art is the best seasoning for good food," and will often invite artists from various walks of life to perform at the restaurant. The intricate interior design also ensures that guests will be able to view the performances no matter where they sit.

entries.name: Bertin's
entries.content: Located in Quartier Lyonnais, Bertin's House of Curiosities is a shop where you can find curiosities ranging from jewels, instruments, perfumes, and souvenirs, to masterpieces. This store is technically a fashion workshop. Its owner collects various curios to gain inspiration.

entries.name: Beaumont Workshop
entries.content: The most renowned forging workshop in the Court of Fontaine, located in Vasari Passage. No matter the request, so long as there are sufficient materials, the improved, fully-automated forging machines can create stunning works according to the engineer's specifications.

entries.name: Chioriya Boutique
entries.content: Chioriya Boutique is a high-end fashion label located in Quartier Lyonnais, owned and run by Chiori, an eccentric lady designer from Inazuma.

entries.name: Damoville Purveyor
entries.content: Damoville Purveyor is the main grocery and general goods shop in Fontaine, located in Vasari Passage and run by Monsieur Boucicaut.

entries.name: Lepaute Horlogerie
entries.content: Lepaute Horlogerie is a small clock shop in Quartier Lyonnais run by a man named Caron.

entries.name: Leschots
entries.content:
Leschots Clockwork Shop, also simply called Leschots's workshop, is run by Livre, who creates mechanical clockwork toys. Alberre and Arbon are employees of the workshop, while Freminet has been commissioned to create toy designs.
Livre maintains a rivalry with his younger brother, Caron, who owns Lepaute Horlogerie and dabbles in making clockwork toys as a side gig from his usual business of designing clocks.

entries.name: Steambird
entries.content: The Steambird is the name of both the main newspaper of the Court of Fontaine, read all across Teyvat, and the office where it is produced. The office stands in Quartier Narbonnais.

entries.name: Pankration Ring
entries.content: The pankration ring is an area within the Fortress of Meropide where inmates and staff alike can engage in friendly fights and community tournaments, wherein the stakes are often Credit Coupons.

entries.name: Maison Gardiennage
entries.content:
The Maison Gardiennage is the law enforcement order of Fontaine, responsible for public order and safety. They have a special branch known as the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol which handles particularly difficult affairs that ordinary Gardes would struggle with.
The following groups are affiliated with the Maison Gardiennage:
- Gardes: the officers in charge of maintaining the security in Fontaine regions, including the Court of Fontaine, along with the Gardemeks.
- Gardemeks: specialist Clockwork Meka that serve the Court of Fontaine. The Gardemeks are in charge of daily security matters, and they aid their corresponding Gardes officers in conducting patrols around the Court of Fontaine.
- Marechaussee Phantom: a special detective force in Fontaine led by the Iudex Neuvillette. Much of the organization is comprised of Melusines due to their powerful eyesight and ability to perceive more than what a normal human can.
- Special Security and Surveillance Patrol: a special department in the Maison Gardiennage, currently led by Chevreuse. They are responsible for solving violent crimes and apprehending said criminals.

entries.name: Melusine
entries.content: Melusines are an all-female species of sentient creatures native to Fontaine. They are the creation of the ancient beast Elynas and are thus considered his daughters. A Melusine is described as diligent with her duties and having a great sense of justice, and they view the Chief Justice Neuvillette as "[their] ideal of the perfect father." Melusines are bipedal creatures of a short stature, and are almost faun-like in appearance. They have long, tufted tails; long ear- or horn-like head protrusions resembling the rhinophores of sea slugs; mitten-like hands; and stubby feet. Some have small wing-like appendages on their backs. Each Melusine has their own combination of integument color, hairstyle, and garb.

entries.name: Sigewinne
entries.content:
Sigewinne is a Melusine with the face and hands of a human and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She is incredibly compassionate and kindhearted, caring equally for everyone who comes to the infirmary, be they inmates, guards, or even cleaning staff. Sigewinne has been serving voluntarily in the Fortress for hundreds of years after having served time for unlawful transformation. Being a Melusine, despite having the appearance of a human, she retains the mischievous spirit of her race and often plants stickers in random locations, including Wriothesley's back or his boxing gloves. Sigewinne has pastel blue bob-cut hair and ears, and fuchsia-pink eyes.
Sigewinne's cooking, meant to help restore stamina, has the prisoners of the Fortress of Meropide call it "mystery meat" and an ill omen despite her efforts in making it. Likewise, Wriothesley describes her milkshakes as "desolation."

entries.name: Furina
entries.content: Furina is the "body and spirit" of the Hydro Archon Focalors, created as a double meant to act as the Hydro Archon and cursed by Focalors with the inability to die or pursue her own happiness so long as Focalors still lived. Furina is a flamboyant actress who lives for the spotlight and is well-loved by the people of Fontaine.

entries.name: Neuvillette
entries.content: Neuvillette is the Chief Justice of Fontaine, also known as the Iudex, renowned for his unassailable impartiality. No one even knows his first name, as he believes that personal ties will impair his sense of justice. While Neuvillette upholds the rules of the court with utmost reverence, he is quite aloof when dealing with human emotions and often distances himself from the public eye. He is held in high regard and with great affection by the Melusines, having been the one to introduce them to Fontainian society. Neuvillette is very tall, with long white hair tied in a black bow near the end, narrow eyes that always appear to show displeasure, and an opulent suit in varying shades of navy and teal. He carries a black cane with a blue gem embedded beneath the handle.

entries.name: Chevreuse
entries.content: Chevreuse is the captain of the Maison Gardiennage's Special Security and Surveillance Patrol of Fontaine, a formidable musketeer and the fiercest member of the Gardes. Chevreuse has a strong sense of justice and is a stalwart executor of the law.

entries.name: Lyney
entries.content: Lyney is the renowned and adored Great Magician of Fontaine, twin brother of Lynette. After the death of his and Lynette's parents and being saved by Arlecchino, Lyney performs missions for the House of the Hearth and is Arlecchino's successor. Lyney has short, straight blonde hair, fair skin, and lavender eyes, and is flamboyant to the point of effeminacy, as well as playfully flirtatious.

entries.name: Lynette
entries.content: Quiet and reserved, Lynette acts as a magician's assistant to her twin brother Lyney. After the death of hers and Lyney's parents and being saved by Arlecchino, Lynette serves as the eyes and ears of the House of the Hearth. Despite being Lyney's twin, she looks only slightly similar to him, having long platinum-blonde hair, deep violet eyes, and cat ears and tail. It is unknown whether she also possesses human ears.

entries.name: Navia
entries.content: Navia Caspar is the president of the Spina di Rosula, an organization in Fontaine that dedicates their time to helping the people of Fontaine and investigating matters that the Gardes would not or have difficulty with. She is the organization's second president, having succeeded her father Callas.

entries.name: Clorinde
entries.content: Clorinde is Fontaine's number one champion duelist for as far back as anyone can remember. She is not easily swayed from her values and sense of justice, nor has she yet lost a duel. Crack shot with a revolver and pistolet and former bodyguard for Furina.

entries.name: Wriothesley
entries.content: Wriothesley is the current administrator of the Fortress of Meropide and was bestowed the title of Duke by the Palais Mermonia. He’s tall and ruggedly built, a talented pugilist, and a champion for justice. His intimidating persona belies an amicable personality and a kind heart.

entries.name: Meka
entries.content: Clockwork Meka are machines originally designed as labourers, but have been modified for combat functionality as well. Meka come in a wide variety of shapes and sizes with an equally wide variety of specializations, from underwater and land survey and patrol, to mining and harvesting, to construction. Gardemeks are meka built specifically for combat and policing.

entries.name: Kamera
entries.content: The Kamera is a Fontainian device used to capture still images on special paper using a series of integrated mirrors. Kameras are bulky and require two hands to operate. Being fairly expensive, Kameras aren’t widely owned—typically, only journalists, professional photographers, and the wealthy own them.

entries.name: Credit Coupons
entries.content: Credit Coupons are the unique currency of the Fortress of Meropide. They can only be earned and spent within the Fortress, and can be used for special meals at the cafeteria, special privileges, items, etc. Credit Coupons are earned through various means, such as overtime in the factory, buying and selling between individuals, and tournaments in the pankration ring.
